payload.claim: Criterion 1 requires `prepare_worktree` to "first print that seed's stderr, then pause at least 60 seconds," but no witness pins that order. `test_a_seed_whose_fetch_fails_once_is_retried_on_a_cleared_volume` only checks that `events == ["seed", "sleep", "seed"]` (tracking the retry's two `run_ephemeral` calls and the mocked `time.sleep`, never the `print` call) and that the first seed's stderr appears somewhere in `capsys.readouterr().out` after the whole case has run. Neither check depends on whether the print happened before or after the sleep. Swapping the two statements at saffron/cell/worktree.py:142-146 so the pause runs first and the trace is printed only afterward still leaves `events == ["seed", "sleep", "seed"]` and still leaves the stderr text somewhere in stdout once the case finishes, so both `test_a_seed_whose_fetch_fails_once_is_retried_on_a_cleared_volume` and `test_a_seed_whose_fetch_fails_twice_raises_after_two_attempts` stay green under that wrong version.
